title: UPC Extraction Set Manifest
description: manifest.json for a query-driven extraction set spanning many sources (extractions/<set-id>/manifest.json). Points at items.jsonl, whose lines each validate against extraction.schema.json.

set_id.description: Set identifier (e.g. set-<slug> or a content id).

query.description: The question/task that defines this extraction set.

items_path.description: Corpus-relative path to items.jsonl for this set.

source_ids.description: Sources this set draws from (advisory index).
